name: Pgbackweb
description: Effortless PostgreSQL backups with a user-friendly web interface!
composeYaml:
services:
  pgbackweb:
    image: 'eduardolat/pgbackweb:latest'
    volumes:
      - 'pgbackweb_backups:/backups'
    environment:
      - 'PBW_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${PGBACKWEB_PASSWORD}'
      - 'PBW_POSTGRES_CONN_STRING=postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-pgbackweb-db}?sslmode=disable'
      - 'TZ=${TIME_ZONE:-UTC}'
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    exclude_from_hc: true
  postgres:
    image: 'postgres:17'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-pgbackweb-db}'
    volumes:
      - 'pgbackweb_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER} -d pgbackweb'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
